annotations.annotation_text: Genetic transition from Book II to Book III. Shaun (sigla ⊐), the corpulent, authoritarian son and bearer of state authority, embarks upon his nocturnal journey floating down the river in a postal barrel (coracle), bearing the maternal letter from ALP to the waiting populace.
sources: McHugh, Roland. The Sigla of Finnegans Wake. University of Texas Press, 1976.
Deane, Vincent, Daniel Ferrer, and Geert Lernout (eds.). The Finnegans Wake Notebooks at Buffalo. Brepols, 2001.
